name: Three.js Scene Generator Cell
description: Interactive cell for generating and prototyping 3D scenes using Three.js from text prompts with AI

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

prompt.description: Text description of the desired 3D scene

isGenerating.description: Flag indicating if scene generation is in progress

selectedModel.description: Selected AI model for code generation

_discovery.describe: AI-powered Three.js scene code generator from text prompts. Generates complete Three.js JavaScript code for 3D scenes including geometry, materials, lighting, and camera setup. Supports multiple AI models (Mistral default) for code generation. Produces executable JavaScript code that can be immediately tested in the cell's integrated Three.js viewport. Processing time ~15-30 seconds. Best for rapid prototyping of 3D scenes, learning Three.js patterns, and generating starter code for custom 3D visualizations. Requires LLM API access.
